subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> = the anime girl character reference sheet (@图1: a single horizontal row of FOUR panels, from left to right - upper-body front view, full-body front view, full-body side view, full-body back view; a 3D Chinese-anime style young woman); long black hair, blue-and-white jade hair ornament with tassels, white-to-light-blue gradient flowing gauze dress, sheer silk ribbons, silver-jade accessories.
<Picture 2> = the product reference photo (@图2): a cylindrical kraft-paper mooncake tube, beige body, red traditional seal-script title "松香百果" (vertical), "老月饼" on top, subtitle "古法自然·复兴中点", side lines "小饼如嚼月" "中有酥和饴", qilin pattern near the bottom.
<Picture 3> = the product reference photo (@图3): a complete round golden mooncake, golden flaky crust with evenly embedded pine-nut granules and natural cracks, plain warm beige solid background.
<Picture 4> = the product reference photo (@图4): a split mooncake, half showing layered flaky crust and black-sesame & pine-nut filling with visible granules.
<Subject 1> = the anime girl from <Picture 1> — appearance kept identical (face, hairstyle, hair ornament, gauze dress), the only character throughout.
<Subject 2> = the cylindrical kraft-paper mooncake tube from <Picture 2> — appearance kept identical.
<Subject 3> = the complete round mooncake from <Picture 3> — appearance kept identical.
<Subject 4> = the split half mooncake from <Picture 4> — appearance kept identical.
<Audio 1> = a warm young Chinese female voice (S1), clear natural delivery, lively pace, e-commerce voiceover style.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second real-world e-commerce ad (single-scene full film): the 3D anime girl from <Picture 1> introduces the Songxiang Baiguo old-style mooncake in a photorealistic traditional Chinese teahouse — presenting the kraft tube, showing and snapping the mooncake apart with force, clean flat break with instant separation, then offering the split half to the viewer outside the frame.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> fully_preserved - the girl's face, hairstyle, hair ornament and flowing gauze dress are kept exactly; the only person on screen.
<Picture 2> fully_preserved - the cylindrical tube, paper texture and all Chinese text are kept exactly.
<Picture 3> fully_preserved - the complete round golden mooncake with pine-nut granules is kept exactly.
<Picture 4> fully_preserved - the split cross-section with black-sesame & pine-nut filling is kept exactly.
<Subject 1> fully_preserved - the anime girl is the single main character, appearance identical to <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> fully_preserved - the mooncake tube looks identical to <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> fully_preserved - EXACTLY ONE complete mooncake, appearance identical to <Picture 3>, no extra pieces.
<Subject 4> fully_preserved - the split half looks identical to <Picture 4>.
ONLY ONE character appears; no other people.

detailed_description:
The shot OPENS on a photorealistic real-world e-commerce short ad in a traditional Chinese teahouse with warm wooden furniture, ceramic tea set and soft warm window light; normal exposure; a single 3D anime-style girl <Subject 1> stands at the teahouse table holding the cylindrical kraft-paper tube <Subject 2> in both hands. The scene feels real and warm, stays the SAME scene throughout, no visual effects.
[Shot 1] Medium shot: <Subject 1> stands behind the wooden table facing the camera with a warm smiling expression, gently raising the tube <Subject 2> toward the camera. At 00:00.500, (S1) says in a warm friendly young female voice: <d>[zh] 小月带来松香百果老月饼。</d> The camera slowly pushes in.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to medium-to-close shot: <Subject 1> picks up the complete mooncake <Subject 3> from the ceramic plate with both hands and shows it to the camera; then snaps it apart with force — the mooncake instantly splits into two complete halves with a clean, flat break, no stickiness, no stringy pull, as crisp as breaking a thin biscuit; a few dry crumbs fall from the broken edges; the camera pushes in on the split cross-section <Subject 4>, the black-sesame and pine-nut filling stays loose and grainy with slight crumble. At 00:05.500, (S1) says in the same warm voice: <d>[zh] 层层起酥，黑芝麻松仁馅。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, cut to a close-up: <Subject 1> holds the split half mooncake <Subject 4> in one hand, steps forward happily one or two steps toward the camera and stops; she extends the half mooncake toward the camera as if inviting the viewer outside the frame to taste it, making a cute inviting expression - bright eyes, gentle smile; her face and the half mooncake are in the same frame, warm and heart-warming. At 00:10.500, (S1) says in a cute warm inviting tone: <d>[zh] 来，请你尝一口！</d> Then a warm freeze frame, gentle fade out.
The girl's warm natural Asian skin tone and exposure stay identical throughout; the mooncake is EXACTLY ONE whole mooncake split into two halves - no extra pieces, no missing parts; no extra people, no extra props; no text, no logo, no watermark, no embedded subtitles.

overall_soundscape:
Traditional teahouse ambience throughout: gentle ceramic tea-cup clinks, faint water boiling, distant soft murmurs; a crisp, light snapping sound when the crust breaks.

non_diegetic_music:
Warm guochao-style background music (guzheng and pipa with light percussion), slow gentle tempo, low volume so the voice-over stays clear; one track consistent across the whole 15s film, ending with a soft, warm resolution.
